verdict.rationale: Mollie documents Mollie Checkout, a hosted checkout where customers pick a payment method and complete payment on Mollie-hosted pages. This sits alongside Components and build-your-own options, and the docs say the hosted pages are optimized for phones and tablets. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the redirect flow via the Payments API checkout URL, evidence of conversion optimization beyond device responsiveness, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
